newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian population estimated at 199.7 million.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian population estimated at 199.7 million.

text.p: Indonesia has estimated its population at the start of 1997 at 199.7 million, the Jakarta Post newspaper reported on Thursday.

It quoted National Planning Board Chairman Haryono Suyono as saying the population was expected to top 200 million in February. He said that a family planning campaign had cut the average number of children in an Indonesian family to 2.6 from six in 1969.
Indonesia is the world's fourth most populous nation behind China, India and the United States.
